rationale: Limit default validation GITHUB_TOKEN capabilities to contents read in canonical and generated workflows, preserving declared job scopes and authenticated cross-run artifact restoration. No class A product change; main CodeQL closure remains a post-publication observation.

summary.ru: Проверки CI явно ограничивают права токена по умолчанию чтением содержимого репозитория.
summary.en: CI validation explicitly limits default token permissions to repository contents read.
